## Behavior change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.
For fixes, include a minimal YAML / NSIS reproduction.

## Validation

List unit tests, build-matrix and real installer results. State tested
architectures, installation scopes, and checks that were not run.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe CLI, configuration, template, dependency, or upgrade changes.
Update both READMEs and the changelog when applicable. Preserve existing demos,
InstallerDemo names, local provenance notes, and third-party licenses.
